messages:
Aisha Patel: Hey team — Novus Health POC starting Monday needs a temporary hosted API QPS bump. They want to demo 200–300 concurrent requests (mostly small prompts, ~300 tokens avg) for a 48-hour window. Can we provision a scoped key and raise limit to 500 QPS for the window? Need CORS + referrer lock.

Ben Cho: How will we bill if they exceed the bump? Do we switch to pay-as-you-go overage or throttle/hard-limit? Customer cares about cost predictability.

Ravi Singh: Quick questions: 1) expected sustained qps vs spikes? 2) payload size confirmed ~300 tokens? 3) are any responses stored or contain PHI?

Aisha Patel: Sustained around 200 qps with short spikes to 300 for a few minutes. Payloads are de-identified for this POC (no PHI). They may send PHI in later phase but not now.

Clara Gomez: I can create a scoped key with referrer and IP restrictions. Example metadata I’ll attach: `name: novus-poc-march2026`, `ttl: 72h`, `allowed_origins: https://demo.novus.health`. Curl to test:```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer NOVUS-POC-xxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1-xl","input":"hi"}'```

Ravi Singh: We can set a soft quota at 500 QPS for 72h and alert at 80% usage. If they exceed sustained limits we can fallback to a lower-tier model automatically. Need infra-oncall + security signoff for temporary bump.

security-bot: Reminder: scoped key + referrer lock required. Confirm no PHI and retention policy = ephemeral (7 days) for logs tied to this key. Also we need a signed AUP — can sales confirm?

Aisha Patel: Confirm no PHI. I’ll get AUP signed today. Need the key by Monday 08:00 PT.

infra-oncall: Approved — I’ll provision the soft 500 QPS window for `novus-poc-march2026`. Will enable dashboard and alerting to #eng-oncall. Setting TTL 72h. If we see sustained >600 QPS for >5m we’ll throttle and notify.

Ben Cho: For billing: recommend we offer a one-time POC addendum — capped spend $X (sales to fill) and then normal usage pricing above. Aisha, want me to draft?

Aisha Patel: Yes please, Ben. I’ll attach the signed AUP when ready. Thanks all — please ping me when key is live so I can share with customer. :thumbsup:

TokenBot: API key created: novus-poc-march2026 (expires in 72h). Note: referrer lock set to https://demo.novus.health

Ravi Singh: Key live and monitoring on. I’ll watch the first hour during demo start.

infra-oncall: Logging/metrics retained per ephemeral policy; if customer moves to production we’ll require Dedicated or Private for PHI handling.

Aisha Patel: Perfect — closing loop.
